` [Highlight start] Vitamin C is not a proven cure for a hangover [Highlight end] ` , though it may play a supportive role in replenishing nutrients and reducing oxidative stress after drinking. Alcohol increases urinary excretion of vitamin C and generates oxidative stress as the body metabolizes it, while evidence for vitamin C alone preventing or curing hangovers remains limited or mixed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXztjAV6gN9X2RL-bkqtaOHEgg5dzgkPrDIKsbNdriZJcRJv8XNcVVJ0gRAqfwg-_yltdVXNHrmoAOTdmIb5E4x2hmlYqj4gnHH4rIFRETiTPEX60lSf842A1Hyb6GS80qC_-p6wvqEy6by7sYa1v7iw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1yKe8Cgr6kgxhhS6jDEGRQ3llbTqCEuJHP2jm6H0z_bTgfqeYPfANW__P44eCXSSb-O1-LEcmK7PCs-i70o_1EIR2OEZUpn5qmSqlWEWoHwB1RXJizJ0G8iNCL5zlLr_8KY4V0GdAIVUUd-U6Hb-8aS1eNnud7mfbtMtA17GSCm4rw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXC9wldKbsZZCEQf9BDGZ0oiUhF-sWT9NRGSwDpvGgbUXihzjNtsfnaihUKdKf5XnQ2VDtZQid_ElFXJWYhRpVz0cojBvx6ugRimVHH3-GQ-qVpk0Vs9DD_kpxsUO8fXmQ6njd5hyrnSiY5Z-x00s)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGD1FctaA-_R6SV9P6-3MhMz-gp8658Hcx4e7LJzQKdZmoC8JbwCdO9x4rKt4vmMlHVaoXB_GdvhOBjVIITMBzibC_VSUl_LfSSJByR8XFZDeox3AN290yLvp4LZaJOZ6W-oj2Z_fMQ)

- **What vitamin C may do:** Acts as an antioxidant to help counter oxidative stress and supports immune function and general recovery. Research reviewed in [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGD1FctaA-_R6SV9P6-3MhMz-gp8658Hcx4e7LJzQKdZmoC8JbwCdO9x4rKt4vmMlHVaoXB_GdvhOBjVIITMBzibC_VSUl_LfSSJByR8XFZDeox3AN290yLvp4LZaJOZ6W-oj2Z_fMQ) notes that alcohol can increase vitamin C loss in urine and highlights early studies on vitamin C and alcohol clearance, though strong clinical proof that it cures hangovers is lacking. By contrast, [BBC Good Food](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXztjAV6gN9X2RL-bkqtaOHEgg5dzgkPrDIKsbNdriZJcRJv8XNcVVJ0gRAqfwg-_yltdVXNHrmoAOTdmIb5E4x2hmlYqj4gnHH4rIFRETiTPEX60lSf842A1Hyb6GS80qC_-p6wvqEy6by7sYa1v7iw) states there is no solid evidence that vitamin C cures or prevents hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGD1FctaA-_R6SV9P6-3MhMz-gp8658Hcx4e7LJzQKdZmoC8JbwCdO9x4rKt4vmMlHVaoXB_GdvhOBjVIITMBzibC_VSUl_LfSSJByR8XFZDeox3AN290yLvp4LZaJOZ6W-oj2Z_fMQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1yKe8Cgr6kgxhhS6jDEGRQ3llbTqCEuJHP2jm6H0z_bTgfqeYPfANW__P44eCXSSb-O1-LEcmK7PCs-i70o_1EIR2OEZUpn5qmSqlWEWoHwB1RXJizJ0G8iNCL5zlLr_8KY4V0GdAIVUUd-U6Hb-8aS1eNnud7mfbtMtA17GSCm4rw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXYzjqgjr5ViJkvqO4KiJZHTHTLiH0Y5A4wN585PNs6VTNDC8JQwCOGVIBsSLaW8IURlk6pbzcw2WPPhym--Z7U6R2L2j04DH9KdToR6ZQ0xN08rBbxUY9QhGrbgc6OOxxqB5lUB6etxtSGyWXzd9KXzge)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXC9wldKbsZZCEQf9BDGZ0oiUhF-sWT9NRGSwDpvGgbUXihzjNtsfnaihUKdKf5XnQ2VDtZQid_ElFXJWYhRpVz0cojBvx6ugRimVHH3-GQ-qVpk0Vs9DD_kpxsUO8fXmQ6njd5hyrnSiY5Z-x00s)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXztjAV6gN9X2RL-bkqtaOHEgg5dzgkPrDIKsbNdriZJcRJv8XNcVVJ0gRAqfwg-_yltdVXNHrmoAOTdmIb5E4x2hmlYqj4gnHH4rIFRETiTPEX60lSf842A1Hyb6GS80qC_-p6wvqEy6by7sYa1v7iw)
- **Community experiences:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF11vy6REsI7eeBkSOys6iUwGGjSn8_e58yE47f92PDSlJX95RyZmGFOe1PGp6Q_hc706lTCITyPncJ_HDwFSfDEmmlbWDX1nz7Hj1GIe29KWyKk6sic3-SlqqNhdnPlKciAllKignFyzMN05qHptKdVoluBK7yNWQemCyLBvGx-srDrr7QkECEs5YpyblDy5h0kWXmGczKA) agree that vitamin and electrolyte drink mixes like Emergen-C can help prevent or ease hangovers mainly by replenishing fluids, electrolytes, and B vitamins.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF11vy6REsI7eeBkSOys6iUwGGjSn8_e58yE47f92PDSlJX95RyZmGFOe1PGp6Q_hc706lTCITyPncJ_HDwFSfDEmmlbWDX1nz7Hj1GIe29KWyKk6sic3-SlqqNhdnPlKciAllKignFyzMN05qHptKdVoluBK7yNWQemCyLBvGx-srDrr7QkECEs5YpyblDy5h0kWXmGczKA)
- **More reliable hangover relief:** Water, electrolytes, rest, and easy-to-digest food address dehydration, low blood sugar, and fatigue more directly than high-dose vitamin C alone.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX_bE_TzcVPrdrBC66Tw__PLN-nV3A8MvRzRqSmFrSyyHLu8S1iyicODFgF9rYTY4dcNa9tP8uKOYkdzUTrWRvJNAKpG3Y5X84AD_jhIs4-qGzIe7blxH2Xp0aNiRnL_1b7vUzxq97LjFmZ7k69A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFQ9DWX_86JW3cxg3RPJHgmY1kSMHG9HMJHFdX33FpCk6EmDRIpKBQDykfVkBUqvgIqlXYaQKZOv4kWNb8NPPVyXF-cylznTEo4VRop4T6UpUVX0HnzdPYq5uPkDBYoKU)
- **Precautions:** Large doses of vitamin C or acidic juices can irritate a sensitive stomach or trigger acid reflux when you already feel nauseous. If you are looking at IV drips or supplements, you can check options like [IV Me Now FL](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX_bE_TzcVPrdrBC66Tw__PLN-nV3A8MvRzRqSmFrSyyHLu8S1iyicODFgF9rYTY4dcNa9tP8uKOYkdzUTrWRvJNAKpG3Y5X84AD_jhIs4-qGzIe7blxH2Xp0aNiRnL_1b7vUzxq97LjFmZ7k69A) or [Halodoc](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1yKe8Cgr6kgxhhS6jDEGRQ3llbTqCEuJHP2jm6H0z_bTgfqeYPfANW__P44eCXSSb-O1-LEcmK7PCs-i70o_1EIR2OEZUpn5qmSqlWEWoHwB1RXJizJ0G8iNCL5zlLr_8KY4V0GdAIVUUd-U6Hb-8aS1eNnud7mfbtMtA17GSCm4rw) , though oral hydration and rest are typically sufficient for mild hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX_bE_TzcVPrdrBC66Tw__PLN-nV3A8MvRzRqSmFrSyyHLu8S1iyicODFgF9rYTY4dcNa9tP8uKOYkdzUTrWRvJNAKpG3Y5X84AD_jhIs4-qGzIe7blxH2Xp0aNiRnL_1b7vUzxq97LjFmZ7k69A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1yKe8Cgr6kgxhhS6jDEGRQ3llbTqCEuJHP2jm6H0z_bTgfqeYPfANW__P44eCXSSb-O1-LEcmK7PCs-i70o_1EIR2OEZUpn5qmSqlWEWoHwB1RXJizJ0G8iNCL5zlLr_8KY4V0GdAIVUUd-U6Hb-8aS1eNnud7mfbtMtA17GSCm4rw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFQ9DWX_86JW3cxg3RPJHgmY1kSMHG9HMJHFdX33FpCk6EmDRIpKBQDykfVkBUqvgIqlXYaQKZOv4kWNb8NPPVyXF-cylznTEo4VRop4T6UpUVX0HnzdPYq5uPkDBYoKU)
